protocol:
1. Set up an Invitrogen E-Gel EX 1% agarose gel cassette on the bench with an E-Gel Power Snap unit open, a micropipette, a tip box, and microcentrifuge tubes kept on ice in a green ice bucket.

2. Fit the micropipette with a clean tip and aspirate an aliquot from a chilled microcentrifuge tube.

3. Load the aliquot into a well of the E-Gel EX 1% agarose cassette.

4. Using clean pipette tips, repeat sample transfer from additional chilled microcentrifuge tubes into separate wells of the E-Gel EX cassette.

5. Place the loaded E-Gel EX cassette into the E-Gel Power Snap dock, seating the cassette flat in the instrument.

6. Close the amber E-Gel Power Snap lid over the loaded cassette.

7. Use the E-Gel Power Snap touchscreen to select the E-Gel EX run program and set the run time to 10:00 min.

8. Start the E-Gel Power Snap run; electrophoresis begins with the lid closed and the timer counting down from 10:00 min.
